entries.speaker: ISABELLA
entries.english: Oh, didn't you know? The Baron owns this land. The great Don Torrisi is just his tenant. Ciao, Gaspare.
entries.turkish: Aa, bilmiyor muydun? Bu topraklar Baron'un. Koca Don Torrisi burada yalnızca kiracı. Ciao, Gaspare.

entries.speaker: TINO
entries.english: Make a mess of this and any misguided faith the Don has in you will be lost, u capisti?
entries.turkish: Bu işi batırırsan Don’un sana beslediği o yersiz güven de yok olur, anladın mı?

entries.speaker: CARLO
entries.english: Don't be an idiota, avoid the main gate.
entries.turkish: Aptallık etme, ana kapıdan uzak dur.
